title: US County GIS 200+ Acre Vacant Land & LLC Owner Extractor

arcgisEndpoints.title: County ArcGIS FeatureServer Layer URLs
arcgisEndpoints.description: Public ArcGIS REST FeatureServer/MapServer layer URLs (e.g., Kenai Peninsula Borough KPB_Parcels FeatureServer/0).

minAcreage.title: Minimum Parcel Acreage
minAcreage.description: Minimum acreage threshold for large-tract vacant land extraction (default: 200 acres).

includeHomestead160.title: Include 160-Acre Homestead Quarter-Sections
includeHomestead160.description: Retains 159-160 acre federal Homestead Act quarter-sections in Tab 1 alongside 200+ acre tracts.

maxImprovementValue.title: Max Minor Improvement Value for Tab 2 Review (USD)
maxImprovementValue.description: Parcels with $0 improvements go to Tab 1. Parcels with $1 up to this threshold (e.g., $2,000 Code 105 sheds) go to Tab 2 for aerial review. Higher values go to Tab 3.

maxLiveParcels.title: Max Additional Live ArcGIS Parcels per Endpoint
maxLiveParcels.description: Maximum number of live parcels to query directly from each ArcGIS REST endpoint per run.

includeVerifiedKpb16.title: Include 16 Verified KPB Benchmark Parcels & Polygons
includeVerifiedKpb16.description: Includes the 16 verified Kenai Peninsula Borough parcels (Tab 1 Qualifying, Tab 2 Review/Trusts, Tab 3 Excluded) with full Polygon and MultiPolygon coordinates.

includeLlcDirectory.title: Include 4-State SFR LLC Principal Mailing Module
includeLlcDirectory.description: Includes the 16 verified single-family residential (SFR) LLC records across FL, GA, AZ, and OH with commercial Registered Agents bypassed.

llcStates.title: Target LLC Registry States
llcStates.description: State Secretary of State registries to include in the LLC mailing tabs (FL Sunbiz, GA SOS, AZ ACC, OH SOS).
